_comment: Idaho 2026 QAP, Idaho Housing and Finance Association. Page numbers are PDF page indices; the printed page number is six lower. Scoring is Section 6 (pp.31-47): twenty Selection Criteria (6.4), five Preference Points (6.5) that the Code requires, and Negative Performance Points (6.6). NO TOTAL IS STATED; 9% applications need 70 points and 4% bond applications 50. Hand-summed before loading from the stated maxima: 6.4 items 5 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 10 + 15 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 5 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 6 = 86, less 3 because older-persons housing (6) cannot take the children points (7), less 1 because the rehabilitation revitalization point (11) and the new construction cost score (14) apply to different project types: 82. Preference Points 15 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 27. Total 109; the loader matched. The same criteria score 4% applications against the 50-point floor; no separate track. Negative points have no maximum. Thresholds (4.9) are in ID_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: No total stated. Computed 109 = Selection Criteria 82 (86 flat, less the older-persons/children and rehabilitation/new-construction exclusions) + Preference Points 27. Minimum 70 for 9%, 50 for 4% (p.31).
